note: V10 R2, hypothesis B with the decision policy's priority (replay restored dev, cross-family did not move): training examples that combine concepts across families. Grammar v3 (ycode.lm.compositions3): aggregate(view(source(input))), each part from a different V8 training family (sources: the list, digits, word lengths, run lengths, letter positions; views: neighbour differences, pair maxima and minima, running maximum, sorted, distinct, odd positions, leaders, after the first; aggregates incl. longest rising stretch, records, best run sum). 334 behaviours, 291 kept after grammar v2's hygiene and dropping C2's own programs; 216 trained x 3 examples. Before training grammar v3 expresses 3 held-out-family tasks (shortest_word_length, window_max_2, window_min_2). From C2, 50% replay, one epoch, lr 1e-4 WSD, seed 1301: one change against R1's recipe, the curriculum.
decision: PLAN.md: selection on dev, unseen-v1, combined /97 and family_new; second seed if combined >= 32 and no failure category loses >= 3 of round 54's items. The benchmark, neighbours, held-out families, reproduction and held-out combinations are reported.
